title: French Cream Puffs
description: Delicate, warm, and buttery cream puffs made with French choux pastry.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium saucepan, combine the water, butter, salt, and sugar. Bring to a boil.
Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a stand mixer and beat in the eggs one at a time.
Add the grated cheese (if using) and mix until combined.
Spoon the mixture into a piping bag fitted with a large round tip.
Pipe small balls of the dough onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the puffs to cool completely before filling with whipped cream.
To make the whipped cream, beat the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add the granulated sugar and mix until combined.
